meta.name: qdrant-migration-tool
meta.description: Guides use of the Qdrant Migration Tool CLI to move vectors, metadata, and sparse embeddings from another vector database into Qdrant. Use when someone asks 'how do I migrate from Pinecone/Weaviate/Milvus/Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/pgvector/s3/Azure/Chroma/Redis/MongoDB/FAISS/Solr to Qdrant', 'move my vector database to Qdrant', 'is there a migration tool for Qdrant', 'my migration got interrupted, how do I resume it', 'migration is too slow', or 'collection wasn't created after migration'. Also use when picking migration batch size, deciding on `--net=host`, or verifying data after a migration.
